contexts.title: Place Stewardship
contexts.definition: Vocabulary for volunteer and community care of shared outdoor places such as trails, parks, greenspaces and community gardens: the places themselves, the organizations that partner on them and the people to contact, the projects and dated milestones in each place's story, the plants put in and watered, the species volunteers learn to tell apart, and the maintenance problems they track to resolution.

contexts.title: Volunteer Engagement
contexts.definition: Vocabulary for how an organization recruits, schedules and counts volunteers: hands-on work days and other volunteer events with their turnout and hours, each person's sign-up with the hours they gave, and requests from schools, companies and other groups to come for a service day.

concepts.definition: A trail, park, greenspace or community garden that a volunteer group or partner organization looks after, with its kind, owning organization, partner organizations, towns, public description and whether it welcomes visiting volunteer groups. Trail-only details such as segments and blazes belong to the trail system it may also be.

concepts.definition: One visit in which someone watered a young tree or other planting, recorded with the date, who did it, roughly how many gallons and any note, optionally during a volunteer event, so a group can see whether new plantings got water in a dry spell.
